cards.name: Rising Elemental

effects.printed_clause: 3 Tuners with different Attributes + 3 non-Tuners with different Attributes.
effects.lua_implementation: AddSynchroMixProcedure requires exactly three Tuners and three non-Tuners; a group check requires three Attribute classes in each subgroup.

official_references.matched_structure: Mixed Tuner/non-Tuner Synchro procedure; the exact 3+3 per-subgroup Attribute uniqueness is custom.

effects.issue: No official Omega script has this exact six-material, independently distinct-Attribute composition; the Lua explicitly enforces it.

effects.printed_clause: While face-up, also WIND, WATER, FIRE, EARTH, and DARK.
effects.lua_implementation: Single-range EFFECT_ADD_ATTRIBUTE adds all five Attribute bits.

official_references.matched_structure: Official multiple-Attribute field treatment via EFFECT_ADD_ATTRIBUTE.

effects.printed_clause: If Synchro Summoned using 6 different Attributes, gains a once-per-turn Quick Effect: banish a GY monster; banish opponent field/GY monsters sharing its Attribute.
effects.lua_implementation: Quick Effect condition checks the six material Attribute classes, banishes one GY monster as cost, stores its Attribute mask, and removes all matching opponent Monster Zone/GY monsters; SOPT count.

official_references.matched_structure: Attribute comparison and mass removal structure on a multi-Attribute Fusion monster.

effects.printed_clause: Unaffected by activated effects of opponent monsters sharing an Attribute with another monster you control.
effects.lua_implementation: EFFECT_IMMUNE_EFFECT now requires an opponent-owned monster effect that is both active-type Monster and re:IsActivated(), then checks whether another face-up controlled monster shares its handler Attribute.

official_references.card_name: Chevreuil, Hunting Scout of the Deep Forest
official_references.matched_structure: Official immunity specifically gates on te:IsActivated()/activated-effect semantics.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the previous immunity omitted re:IsActivated() and therefore also blocked continuous and other non-activated monster effects.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed and fixed the activated-effect immunity boundary. The exact six-material independently distinct-Attribute Synchro composition remains an unresolved custom-reference gap.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
